subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five memory roles, per-agent overrides, legacy `memory` migration behavior, and opt-in `memoryRole` hook filtering as the permanent public plugin/config contract?
rationale: The implementation creates durable user config and third-party plugin API semantics; source correctness cannot decide the permanent taxonomy, inheritance rules, or migration window without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the role contract
options.body: Approve the five roles and per-agent selection, require the mechanical fix and final-head upgrade proof, then land the architecture.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Ship only the highest-confidence roles or global selection first and defer the remaining roles and per-agent overrides.

options.title: Keep single-owner memory
options.body: Decline the new core contract and leave advanced composition to narrower plugin-owned orchestration or a future RFC.

recommendation.title: Adopt the role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the five roles and per-agent selection, require the mechanical fix and final-head upgrade proof, then land the architecture.

likelyOwner.reason: The central plugin, memory runtime, config, and SDK files show the strongest and most recent product/runtime ownership by Peter Steinberger.
